findings.title: Removing `findMany` breaks the exported service API
findings.body: `findMany` was the service's data-access API and applied the authorization and filter predicates together with caller-provided `findMany` arguments. This change removes it and exposes only a raw SQL fragment, while no dependent call sites are migrated in this PR. Existing consumers of `InsightsBookingService.findMany` will fail to compile/run, and replacement callers must now independently choose the correct table/view and reimplement Prisma query features such as selection, ordering, pagination, and additional `where` clauses. Preserve a compatible query method or update all consumers as part of this change.
